div.div: 6 تراصّوا They placed themselves close together, (Ks, S, M, A, K,) in a rank, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) in prayer, (A, TA,) and in battle, (TA,) so that there was no intervening space among them; (Ks;) as also ↓ ارتصّوا : (A:) they placed themselves in a rank, or in ranks, in battle, and in prayer. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
